guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：資安事件應變演練
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Cybersecurity incident-response exercises
guides.concept: 以偵測、遏止與業務復原的協調串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect coordination of detection, containment and business recovery with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「授權範圍」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：演練的系統、資料與處置許可權應事先確定。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以玩具環境寫出允許和禁止的處置。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「演練注入」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：注入情境需分開預期行為與不可預知分支。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「設計假想服務中斷而不執行真實攻擊。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「事件分級」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：分級需同時考慮影響與確定度。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較高影響低確定度與低影響高確定度。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「證據與復原」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：急速復原可能改寫尚未儲存的證據。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較先取樣與先重啟的資料保留情境。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「通知紀錄」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：通知應依已確認事實、時點與責任角色。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「撰寫匿名演練摘要並標示未證實項。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「修正追蹤」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：改善事項需負責人、到期與重演證據。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「將一項流程缺口轉成可觀察的再次演練。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for exercise authority. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Systems, data and response authority are defined before exercises. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify allowed and prohibited actions in a toy environment. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for exercise injects. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Injects distinguish expected behavior and uncertain branches. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Design fictional service disruption without attacking systems. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for incident severity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Severity accounts for impact and confidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare high-impact uncertain and low-impact certain cases. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for evidence and recovery. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rapid recovery can overwrite unpreserved evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare sampling-first and restart-first evidence retention. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for communication records. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Communication follows confirmed facts, timing and accountable roles. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Write an anonymous exercise brief with unconfirmed items marked. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for corrective-action tracking. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Actions need owners, deadlines and re-exercise evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Turn a process gap into an observable repeat exercise. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「復盤因果」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「故障後最後一個變更必然是原因。」為何不成立。
提交「修正追蹤」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「將一項流程缺口轉成可觀察的再次演練。」如何辨別它們。
提交「修正追蹤」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「寫下改善建議便等於風險已降低。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for review causality; explain why this claim fails: The last preceding change is necessarily the cause.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for corrective-action tracking; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for corrective-action tracking; explain why this claim fails: Writing a recommendation means risk is reduced.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：寫下改善建議便等於風險已降低。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Writing a recommendation means risk is reduced. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
guides.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

practice: 畫出本課與「軟體弱點管理流程」共用的資料／元件介面；以「共同使用資產盤點與版本證據」指出能保留的條件。
針對「應變需在不完整資訊下決策」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with software vulnerability-management workflows; use "Both use asset inventories and version evidence" to identify retained conditions.
For "Response must decide with incomplete information", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.
